purpose: Supply immutable replayable tooling for the two remaining provisional blockers without altering the candidate or prior dispositions.

validator_resolution.semantics: Deterministic structural validation only; no authority or admission effect.

safety_properties: Binds execution to an exact normalized PEMS/2 base SHA-256.
Requires Steward-supplied canonical IDs; the tool does not perform identity admission.
Fails on new record or relation ID collisions.
Fails on missing reused canonical records or dangling relation endpoints.
Requires derived propositions to have derived_from premise relations.
Enforces canonical contradiction endpoint order and rejects native legacy_untyped dependencies.
Validates the complete candidate against the normative PEMS/2 JSON Schema.
Emits complete PEMS/2 JCS and COVE/1|PEMS/2|JCS/1 candidate artifacts rather than patching canonical memory.
Proves COVE structural round trip and repeated deterministic PEMS/COVE bytes before emitting an admission proof.
Never writes canonical repository paths; Steward installation remains a separate authority step.
canonical_transaction_resolution.required_steward_input: A complete rgp-pems2-admission-transaction/1 plan containing the exact current base hash, reused canonical record IDs, and complete new PEMS/2 record/relation envelopes chosen by authoritative reconciliation.

requested_steward_action: Independently replay rgp-validator/1, create the authoritative transaction plan from the already reconciled identities/provenance plus any required new canonical source chain, execute the deterministic admission tool against the exact current PEMS/2 base, inspect its proof and complete outputs, and issue a new superseding disposition.
